parameters.name: UnderflowErrorsSent
parameters.description: Number of underflow errors sent, i.e. on the transmit side of the interface.

parameters.name: CRCErrorsReceived
parameters.description: Number of CRC errors received, i.e. on the receive side of the interface.

parameters.name: AlignmentErrorsReceived
parameters.description: Number of alignment errors received, i.e. on the receive side of the interface.

parameters.name: ShortPacketsReceived
parameters.description: Number of short packets received, i.e. on the receive side of the interface.

parameters.name: LongPacketsReceived
parameters.description: Number of long packets received, i.e. on the receive side of the interface.

parameters.name: OverflowErrorsReceived
parameters.description: Number of overflow errors received, i.e. on the receive side of the interface.

parameters.name: PauseFramesReceived
parameters.description: Number of pause frames received, i.e. on the receive side of the interface.

parameters.name: FramesDropped
parameters.description: Number of frames dropped, e.g. because the receive queue is full.

object.description: Per-channel {{bibref|G.998.2}} Ethernet-based bonding statistics. These relate to the {{bibref|G.998.2}} PME (Physical Medium Entity) Aggregation Function (PAF) lower layer (per-channel) interfaces. The CPE MUST reset the Stats parameters either when the interface becomes operationally down due to a previous administrative down (i.e. the interface's {{param|###.Status}} parameter transitions to a down state after the interface is disabled) or when the interface becomes administratively up (i.e. the interface's {{param|###.Enable}} parameter transitions from {{false}} to {{true}}). Administrative and operational interface status is discussed in {{bibref|TR-181i2|section 4.2.2}}.
